projection_description: plain gnomonic: raw linear NDC (u,v) fed directly into the standard cube face embedding, matching app/src/field/bakeCube.ts's EXISTING (already-shipped) bake exactly
format: RGBA16Float (uint16 little-endian bit patterns), row-major, index = (px + py*face_size)*4 + channel
face_convention: matches THREE.CubeTexture images order; texel (px,py) -> u,v=((idx+0.5)/size)*2-1 in [-1,1]; row 0 = v=-1 (flipY=false, matches app/src/field/bakeCube.ts)

geodetic_to_geocentric.note: cube direction (geocentric) converted to geodetic latitude before sampling the EPSG:4326 source raster; see build/wgs84.py

channels.R: natural-log density: log(max(density_per_sqm, floor)); floor=1.0; decode with exp(R). Unit: nematodes/m^2. Unchanged by this update -- see validation.r_a_byte_identical.
channels.G: structure fraction: (omnivores + predators) / (sum of the five functional-group per100gSoil grids), in [0,1]. Denominator is the SUM OF THE FIVE GROUPS, not TotalNumber -- the two do NOT reconcile on real data (see validation.summation_trap): the five groups were modelled independently of TotalNumber_per100g.tif and sum to it with a global area-weighted ratio of 1.0875 (per-pixel ratio ranges 0.538 to 2.330). Normalising by TotalNumber instead would silently encode that model disagreement as ecology -- see the channel ruling. Provenance: ETH Research Collection doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000354394 (item 6f6b1997-f1ba-4c85-8fc6-a7d68dc71234), files bacterivores_per100gSoil.tif, fungivores_per100gSoil.tif, herbivores_per100gSoil.tif, omnivores_per100gSoil.tif, predators_per100gSoil.tif.
channels.B: bootstrap coefficient of variation (per-pixel model uncertainty), un-diluted to the land-only mean (see uncertainty.land_mean_from_diluted -- extract_grid's box average treats ocean as 0 for mass conservation, which is correct for a density but would silently understate uncertainty at coastal cells for a per-soil-sample statistic like CV). Dimensionless (std/mean of the 100-iteration bootstrap distribution). Deliberately NOT TotalNumber_Ensemble_CoefVar.tif -- seed-to-seed jitter of a single model run, not real bootstrap uncertainty -- shares the convenient 43201x21121 grid but would read as 'confidence' while measuring nothing of the kind. See the channel ruling. Provenance: ETH Research Collection doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000354035 (item 73e5c336-f3bd-46a7-990e-150ac581bc28), file TotalNumber_Bootstrap_CoefVar.tif, on a 43200x21120 native grid (one fewer row/column than the main 43201x21121 density grid, same tiepoint/pixel-scale) -- resampled via the same box-averaging extract_grid already uses for R, landing on the identical output mapping with no separate coordinate transform (see rebake_gb.py's module docstring for why that is exact for this grid, not an approximation).
channels.A: land fraction (0..1), unmodified from source extraction. Unchanged by this update -- see validation.r_a_byte_identical.

polar_gap.note: no source data beyond +/-88 deg geodetic; texels landing there are explicit no-data (R decodes to floor, A=0), not extrapolated

not_used_ensemble_coefvar.reason: seed-to-seed jitter of a single model run, not real bootstrap uncertainty -- shares the convenient 43201x21121 grid but would read as 'confidence' while measuring nothing of the kind. See the channel ruling.

floored_texel_audit.note: ~70% of texels decode to the DENSITY_FLOOR placeholder (log(1.0)) rather than a real measurement. That is expected, not a bug: Earth is ~70% ocean, the source raster is NaN there (converted to density=0 at extraction time), and this bake floors density=0 to avoid storing log(0)=-inf. Confirmed below by cross-checking the A (land_fraction) channel: every floored texel has land_fraction exactly 0 -- if this were ever >0 it would mean real land got clamped to the floor, which would be a genuine bug.

summation_trap.note: do the five functional-group grids sum to the independently modelled TotalNumber_per100g grid? NO -- see per_pixel_ratio_* below. G is normalised by sum_five (the five groups), not TotalNumber, per the channel ruling.
